name: inprocess-obi-apb-timer-nondivisor-ratio-refusal
description: One Ibex RVFI CPU at its pinned 50 MHz declaration and one PULP APB3 timer declared at 30 MHz. The entry refuses the session by name: the declared ratio is not an integer half-period divider, and a phase grid cannot state both declared rates. No model is run and no bus success is reported.
notes: The 30 MHz profile is a declared composition variant of the pinned PULP apb_timer; the pinned 50 MHz profile is not edited.

The expected refusal is "unsupported: declared clock rates differ (...); the ratio between the reference CPU (50000000 Hz) and target:timer_refusal (30000000 Hz) is not an integer divider ...".  The specific name states the exact contract rather than rounding 5/3 to a whole divider.
